title: Ben's Food
text:
Ben likes breakfast. Every morning he eats bread and an egg. He drinks a glass of milk. He likes orange juice too, but only on Sundays.

At lunch, Ben eats soup with his mother. For dessert, they have an apple. Ben does not like tea, so he drinks water.

questions.text: What does Ben eat every morning?
What does Ben not like to drink?
Why is orange juice a special drink for Ben?
options: He drinks it only on Sundays, so it is a treat
He cannot buy it in his town

questions.text: Where does Ben probably eat lunch?

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
a warm liquid food made with water and vegetables or meat
a sweet food eaten at the end of a meal
a round, sweet fruit that is red, green or yellow

paragraph_translations: Бен любить сніданок. Щоранку він їсть хліб і яйце. Він п'є склянку молока. Він також любить апельсиновий сік, але тільки по неділях.
У обід Бен їсть суп з мамою. На десерт вони мають яблуко. Бен не любить чай, тому п'є воду.
